rows.grounds: conjunction adding to the preceding list
fused form: siddhi-saṃprāptiḥ (attainment of powers) + mūlakaulam (root Kaula); sandhi noted, token kept whole

items.question: What attainment is identified as belonging to the root Kaula, O fair-faced one?
premises: These accomplishments are linked to attainment.
This attainment is identified as the root Kaula.
items.inference: The attainment of the eight siddhis constitutes the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact internal compound structure of siddhisaṃprāptirmūlakaulaṃ is compressed by sandhi and fusion.
items.plain_english: And the attainment of the eight siddhis is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
